newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers' bus overturns in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers' bus overturns in West Bank.

text.p: A bus carrying Israeli troops overturned in the West Bank on Wednesday, injuring three soldiers, after Palestinians threw a petrol bomb at the vehicle, Jewish settlers said.
Palestinian security officials confirmed a bus with soldiers had overturned near Jalazoun refugee camp, north of Jerusalem, but gave no details. The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
"There was an incident at about 1:30 (1030 GMT) as a result of a petrol bomb being thrown at a bus with soldiers. The bus overturned and burned," said Aharon Domb, a settler spokesman.
"There are about three wounded in fair to serious condition. Others sustained light injuries," he said.
Violence has flared for two weeks in the West Bank since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
U.S. President Bill Clinton will meet Netanyahu in Washington on Monday for talks on saving Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations.
